D: A mess of New Yorkers chase love and second chances in the hours before the ball drops in Times Square.
P: Serve the drinks as the ball drops at midnight.
S: Laura's prawn and avocado tostada bites
Crisp tortilla rounds with prawns and avocado

Crisp mini tortilla rounds with smashed avocado, chilli lime prawns, pickled onion and coriander, the kind of bite a chef sends out first. Cut 16 rounds from 4 corn tortillas with a 6cm cutter, brush with oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Toss 16 peeled cooked prawns with the juice of 1 lime and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes. Mash 2 avocados with lime juice and salt. Thinly slice half a red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes. Top each crisp with avocado, a prawn, a few onion slivers and a coriander leaf.
Times Square halal cart chicken skewers
Spiced chicken skewers on pita with white sauce and hot sauce

Cumin and turmeric marinated chicken skewers, chargrilled and drizzled with garlicky white sauce and red chilli sauce on warm pita. Toss 600g diced chicken thigh with 2 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp coriander, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt. Marinate 30 minutes, thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 minutes, turning. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 100g Greek yoghurt, 1 tsp white vinegar, 1 crushed garlic clove and a pinch of sugar. Warm 4 pita breads. Serve skewers on pita with white sauce, hot chilli sauce and shredded lettuce.
M: Linguine with garlic butter prawns and crunchy toasted breadcrumbs

Linguine tossed with garlic butter king prawns, chilli, white wine, lemon and parsley, finished with toasted breadcrumbs for crunch. Cook 400g linguine in salted water. Toast 40g panko in 1 tbsp oil until golden. Heat 40g butter and 2 tbsp oil, add 4 sliced garlic cloves and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes for 1 minute, then add 600g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes. Add 100ml white wine and bubble 1 minute. Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley. Top with the crumbs.
W: Dark chocolate and cream fondue with orange zest, strawberries to dip

Warm dark chocolate fondue with a hint of orange, for dunking strawberries, marshmallows, brownie cubes and pretzels as the clock runs down. Heat 200ml thickened cream until steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute, then stir until glossy. Stir in the zest of 1 orange and a pinch of salt. Keep warm in a fondue pot or a bowl over hot water. Serve with 250g strawberries, 100g marshmallows, a 300g brownie cut into cubes and a handful of pretzels on skewers.
K: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup topped with champagne

Gin, fresh lemon and sugar syrup shaken cold and topped with champagne, with a long lemon twist. Chill 4 flutes. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 10ml sugar syrup with ice and strain into a flute. Top slowly with about 90ml chilled champagne or sparkling wine. Add a long twist of lemon peel. For anyone not drinking, mix lemon juice and syrup with sparkling white grape juice.

veg.make_ahead: Crisps and onion up to 1 day ahead, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Cut small rounds from the tortillas with a 6cm cutter and brush with oil. Bake at 200C until crisp, then cool.
Cut the haloumi into 16 small squares and fry in a dry non-stick pan until golden on both sides.
Toss the hot haloumi with lime juice and chilli flakes.
Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
Thinly slice the red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes.
Top each crisp with avocado, a piece of haloumi, a few onion slivers and a coriander leaf.

dishes.n: Times Square halal cart chicken skewers
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss with oil, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, coriander, crushed garlic and salt.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, vinegar, crushed garlic and a pinch of sugar into a white sauce.
Grill the skewers, turning, until cooked through.
Warm the pita and shred the lettuce.
Serve the skewers on pita with white sauce, chilli sauce and lettuce.

veg.n: Times Square halal cart spiced tofu skewers

steps.text: Press the tofu under a heavy board, then cut into cubes and toss with oil, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, coriander, crushed garlic and salt.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread the tofu onto skewers.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, vinegar, crushed garlic and a pinch of sugar into a white sauce.
Grill the skewers, turning, until golden and charred at the edges.
Warm the pita and shred the lettuce.
Serve the skewers on pita with white sauce, chilli sauce and lettuce.
